{{Quote|Hey!|The Nautolan trooper, upon spotting Jedi Knight Kerra Holt|<ref name="Knight Errant (novel)">[[Knight Errant (novel)|''Knight Errant'']]</ref>}}
This [[Nautolan/Legends|Nautolan]] '''trooper''' served the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Daiman]] at the [[Battle of Gazzari]] in [[1032 BBY/Legends|1032 BBY]]. A [[Spice/Legends|spice]] addict, the trooper clung tightly to a container of spice when he spotted the [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Kerra Holt]]. Holt grabbed hold of the Nautolan's head tentacles and kneed the trooper in the face before suffocating the trooper with his own tentacle.
